gate_rule: One-seed screening candidate requires higher test Sharpe, higher benchmark-excess Sharpe and return, no material drawdown deterioration, paired/fold support, no inactivity, no turnover-only warning, and a better gate score than the overregularized negative control.
g3_implication: Do not prepare G3 unless at least one non-negative-control G2 candidate is confirmed with a 3-seed rerun.
